violations.text: The door to the outside, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the dish machine. New Violation. Correct By: 06/17/2026
The receptacle in the women's toilet room is lacking a cover. A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. New Violation. Correct By: 06/17/2026
Several locations in the facility have an accumulation of rodent droppings. Areas to be cleaned. New Violation. Correct By: 06/17/2026

The door to the outside, located near the bar, is not tight-fitting. Door sweep to be extended. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 11/27/2024

Wood is used in the construction of the mop sink and the bar. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other food soiling or that require frequent cleaning must be constructed of a nonabsorbent and smooth material. New Violation. Correct By: 12/11/2024
The door to the toilet room's is not self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 11/27/2024
